nights.name: Cleopatrick
nights.extract: Cleopatrick is a Canadian rock duo based in Cobourg, Ontario. They released their debut album, Bummer, on June 4, 2021 and three EPs by their own record label, called Nowhere Special Recordings. Their second album, Fake Moon, was released on March 14, 2025.

en.who: Cleopatrick is a Canadian rock duo based in Cobourg, Ontario. Cleopatrick released its debut album, Bummer, on June 4, 2021, and three EPs on its own label, Nowhere Special Recordings. Cleopatrick's second album, Fake Moon, was released on March 14, 2025.
